overview.description: Invesco Nasdaq International Innovators 100 ETF is an exchange-traded fund that seeks to track the performance of the Nasdaq International Innovators 100 Index. The fund provides exposure to 100 large- and mid-cap companies outside the United States selected based on innovation-related factors, including research and development spending, revenue growth, and gross margins.
